about.title: About and privacy
about.p1: JANASEVA AI is a hackathon prototype built by students. It is not a government website and is not endorsed by any department.
about.p2: Eligibility is checked by fixed rules taken from scheme records. The AI only explains results in simple words. Always confirm with the official department.
about.p3: We do not ask for Aadhaar numbers, passwords or OTPs. Uploaded documents are read and then discarded. Your profile is linked only to this browser, and 'Clear profile' deletes it together with your drafts.

verify.title: Document Verification
verify.intro: Ask your grama panchayat to check a document against its household records. Verification is not approval of any scholarship - you still apply through the official process.
verify.linkHint: Enter the household reference and link code printed on your panchayat survey slip. Your request will go only to the panchayat that holds your household record.
verify.demoHint: Demo: household HH-01-W1-0001 with link code LINK-1001 (fictional).
verify.identityNote: Demonstration identity only - this browser is linked to the household. Real use needs proper sign-in.
verify.newRequest: Ask your panchayat to verify a document
verify.purpose: What is it for? (e.g. scholarship name)
verify.fileHint: PDF, PNG or JPG, up to 5 MB. Stored privately; only authorised panchayat officials can open it.
verify.none.requests: You have not sent any verification requests yet.
verify.cannotCheck: Your panchayat cannot certify this type itself - it will probably be referred to the issuing authority.
verify.notApproval: This is not a scholarship approval.
submit.title: Submit your application

submit.notEnoughHint: Fix each item below, then check again.
submit.ready: All required information is present. Please review your application.
submit.previewHint: Read every page. If anything is wrong, tell us what to change - nothing is submitted yet.
submit.openPdf: Open the PDF in a new tab
submit.changeHint: Also correct the fields in 'Application details' above. Your note is kept in the application history.
submit.updated: Changes saved. Please review the new preview.
submit.confirmCheck: I have read the whole application and the information is correct.
submit.nextStep: Keep this PDF. Use it when you apply through the official portal or at your Akshaya centre.
